briefs: docs/round10/track-m3.md (read M30 and docs/round10/track-d0.md D0-2 and D0-3 first)
notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: D0 (shared mob registry, merged before M3 starts), D (trial spawners, vaults, lodestones, breezes), W (darkness, vibrations, sculk, warden), E1 and E2 (known limits), F (Elden Ring boss), M1 (land animals), M2 (water and buckets) and this track, M3 (lightning, phantoms, creakings, copper golems, undead horses, camels, happy ghasts and allays: registry group `night`, bytes 80-95, with the horse kinds in the cow store, byte 11), where every registered family follows the D0-3 plug-in checklist, only M3 edits the cow-store horse lines, and segment m3a starts only after D0's d0a is merged into minecraft-survival (M30). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL, even where a brief says to: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new enum variants, match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small. Record decisions in the track log. RESTARTS: if this run was started again after a stop (the PC crashed on 2026-10-28 at 20:27 with six tracks building), the worktree may hold the current group's half-done work as uncommitted or staged changes: read `git status` and `git diff` (and `git diff --cached`) first, keep what is correct, finish the group and commit it; discard only what is broken. If cargo reports invalid or corrupt metadata, a truncated .rlib/.rmeta or a link error on a file that should exist, run `& .\scripts\cargo-slot.ps1 +target=<this track's target> clean -p <crate>` for that crate and build again. LOAD: builds now run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process.

groups.prompt: Track M3 group lightning-strikes (segment m3a, the track's first group; read M30 first): build track-m3.md section M3-1, commit group 1 (P8, no mob family). Two commits: 'Minecraft lightning bolts set fires and hurt what they strike' (new world/src/level/lightning.rs with lightning_fire, the hits on level items and orbs, add_lightning(pos, visual_only) and a seed and uuid on LightningData; Hazard::LightningBolt through D0's generic Exposed arm and every old family's Exposed; players through Output.players_lightning with no knockback and no shield block, the fire rule and the death line; /summon minecraft:lightning_bolt; the rod's level event 3002; entities world.rs gets mod lightning with pub use lightning::{Bolt, ThunderOutcome}; the terrain lightning.rs functions take the ServerSim fields as arguments from one-line calls in server.rs, because those fields and add_saved_entity are private to server.rs; if W's lightning_strike game event sits at summon_lightning, move it into the bolt tick at life == 2) and 'Registered Minecraft mobs can answer lightning their own way' (Family::thunder_hit after fire_immune in D0's root families.rs, with its family_group! dispatch and Families::thunder_hit). The conversions are the next group, lightning-turns. Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m3-log.md and the M3 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md

Track M3 group lightning-turns (segment m3a, needs lightning-strikes): build track-m3.md section M3-1, commit group 2. One commit: 'Minecraft lightning turns pigs, villagers, creepers and mooshrooms like vanilla' (single conversions from converted_zombie_tag without equipment and drop chances, plus effects, absorption and age; EntityWorld::thunder_hit returning ThunderOutcome::Convert and crate::lightning::strike returning the new tags to its server.rs line, which hands each to add_saved_entity; the persistent zombified piglin with a golden sword and no finalize, a baby pig giving a baby piglin; the witch with finalize_conversion, its POIs released as in infect_villagers and a diag::info! line; charged creepers through powered; the mooshroom flip once per bolt UUID with its sound and no damage; Peaceful only hurts the pig and the villager). Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m3-log.md and the M3 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md

Track M3 group lightning-drawn (segment m3a, needs lightning-strikes): build track-m3.md section M3-1, commit group 3. One commit: 'Minecraft lightning bolts flash and thunder for every player' (lightning_render.rs ported from LightningBoltRenderer from the bolt's seed, 224 quads and 128 blocks tall; a new additive draw pass in render_gpu (ONE, ONE, depth test without write, no cull) with its WGSL and the entity_meshes slot count raised to 7; EntitySnapshot.lightning filtered at 16 chunks for friends, noted under '## Protocol'; thunder and impact once per bolt id; the sky flash for host and friend through environment.rs and SkyInputs). The charged creeper layer and the rod sparks are the next group, lightning-glow. Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m3-log.md and the M3 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md

Track M3 group lightning-glow (segment m3a, needs lightning-drawn's additive pass): build track-m3.md section M3-1, commit group 4. One commit and one optional: 'Minecraft charged creepers glow with their energy swirl' (CreeperPowerLayer on the additive pass with the scrolling armour texture along the armour glint's path; drop the creeper_render.rs note) and, optional, 'Minecraft lightning rods spark when struck' (level event 3002 presented as electric sparks, its constant after LECTERN_PAGE_TURN in level_events.rs and its arm after that arm, Kind::ElectricSpark next to Kind::Crit in ambient_particles.rs, the storm animateTick of a surface rod in display_ticks.rs; skip it to left for later if the group runs long). Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m3-log.md and the M3 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md
